info.name: FitConnect API
info.description:
Complete API collection for FitConnect backend.

Variables:
- base_url: https://fitconnectbackend-production.up.railway.app/api/v1
- token: Firebase ID token (get from firebase-auth-test app)
- admin_token: Firebase ID token for admin user

request.description:
Call this after any Firebase sign-in (Google, Apple, Phone OTP).
Registers the user in Supabase if they are new. Safe to call multiple times (idempotent).

Requires: Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>

Response: { id, user_type, onboarding_completed, is_new_user }

Revokes Firebase refresh tokens and removes device push tokens from DB.
The mobile client must also call FirebaseAuth.signOut() locally.
Returns full profile of the logged-in user.
Returns public profile of any user.

Step 1 of individual onboarding. Marks onboarding_completed = true.

gender: male | female | non_binary | prefer_not_to_say
fitness_level: beginner | intermediate | advanced
preferred_gender_filter: everyone | men | women | women_only

specialty is an array (multi-select).

Update any editable profile fields.

preferred_gender_filter, preferred_training_time, latitude, longitude, location,
specialty, credentials, years_of_experience, session_rate,
prompt_philosophy, prompt_best_result, prompt_love_working
Returns up to 6 ordered profile photos. { photos: [{ id, url, position }] }

formdata.description: JPG/PNG/WEBP, max 10 MB each. Send multiple files in one request.

request.description:
Upload 1–6 profile photos as multipart/form-data. Max 6 photos total.
Position 1 photo becomes the avatar_url.
Replace a single photo at the same position. Overwrites storage.

formdata.description: Use the photoId UUID as the field name for each file

request.description:
Replace multiple photos in one request.
Field name = the photoId to replace. Value = new file.
Delete a profile photo. Must keep at least 1 photo.

Change photo order. Positions must be 1–6, unique, all belong to this user.
Position 1 becomes avatar_url.

formdata.description: NSCA-CSCS | ACE | NASM-CPT | RYT-200 | Precision Nutrition | Other

request.description:
Upload a professional certification. multipart/form-data.
cert_type is required. Document file is optional.
Verified certifications get a badge and rank higher in search.

List all certifications for the logged-in user.
Response: { certifications: [{ id, cert_type, custom_type, document_url, issue_date, expiry_date, issuing_org, is_verified }] }
View certifications for any professional (used on their profile card).
Deletes certification and removes document from Supabase Storage.

query.description: Filter chip: all | gym | yoga | physio | sports | run | event
Max distance in km when lat/lng provided (default 50)

request.description:
Events tab on the Explore screen. Returns upcoming community events.
Each event includes is_going (whether user has RSVP'd).
Filter by type chip and/or calendar date. Pass lat/lng for distance-sorted results.

Toggle attendance for a public event.
Returns { is_going: true } if joined, { is_going: false } if left.

query.description:
Filter: all | gym | yoga | physio | sports | pool | crossfit | studio | other

type=all → parallel fetch from gym+physio+sports_club+swimming_pool types, returns fitness places only (no spa)
Specific type → single Google Places call with keyword + tag filter

request.description:
Nearby fitness places via Google Places Nearby Search API.

Always returns filters[] for frontend chips:
[
  { key: "all",      label: "All",      icon: "filter_list"    },
  { key: "gym",      label: "Gyms",     icon: "fitness_center" },
  { key: "yoga",     label: "Yoga",     icon: "self_improvement" },
  { key: "physio",   label: "Physio",   icon: "medical_services" },
  { key: "sports",   label: "Sports",   icon: "sports"         },
  { key: "pool",     label: "Pool",     icon: "pool"           },
  { key: "crossfit", label: "CrossFit", icon: "directions_run" },
  { key: "studio",   label: "Studio",   icon: "music_note"     },
  { key: "other",    label: "Other",    icon: "spa"            }
]

Each place: place_id, name, address, rating, reviews, is_open, tags[], photo_url, distance_km
